If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overestimating rebound.  
If sentiment is positive and price is trending down, add 0.5–1.5% to forecast in mid-horizon (8–15 days) to counteract sentiment-driven overcorrection.  
If sentiment is mixed and price is near support, reduce forecast by 1–2% in late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overshoot.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% in early horizon to avoid sentiment-driven inflation.  
If sentiment is negative and price is near resistance, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast in mid-horizon to avoid premature reversal.  
If sentiment is neutral and price is volatile, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% in late horizon to dampen noise-driven overconfidence.
